label: Change BitLocker password
behaviour: Shown only where (System.Volume.BitLockerProtection:=System.Volume.BitLockerProtection#On OR System.Volume.BitLockerProtection:=System.Volume.BitLockerProtection#Encrypting OR System.Volume.BitLockerProtection:=System.Volume.BitLockerProtection#Suspended) AND System.Volume.BitLockerCanChangePassphraseByProxy:=System.StructuredQueryType.Boolean#True; no item read met that condition.

label: Change BitLocker PIN
behaviour: Shown only where (System.Volume.BitLockerProtection:=System.Volume.BitLockerProtection#On OR System.Volume.BitLockerProtection:=System.Volume.BitLockerProtection#Encrypting OR System.Volume.BitLockerProtection:=System.Volume.BitLockerProtection#Suspended) AND System.Volume.BitLockerCanChangePin:=System.StructuredQueryType.Boolean#True; no item read met that condition.

label: Open command &window here
behaviour: Hidden on the reference build by its feature flag (HideBasedOnVelocityId 6527944).

label: Turn on &BitLocker
behaviour: On extended-drive it shares its label with encrypt-bde-elev, and the menus do not say which of them is shown.

label: Turn on &BitLocker
behaviour: Shown on drive; on extended-drive it shares its label with encrypt-bde, and the menus do not say which of them is shown; it applies only where (System.Volume.BitLockerProtection:=System.Volume.BitLockerProtection#Off OR System.Volume.BitLockerProtection:=System.Volume.BitLockerProtection#OnPreProvisioned) AND System.Volume.BitLockerRequiresAdmin:=System.StructuredQueryType.Boolean#True.

label: find
behaviour: Disabled (LegacyDisable): no menu shows it.

label: Manage &BitLocker
behaviour: Shown only where System.Volume.BitLockerProtection:=System.Volume.BitLockerProtection#On OR System.Volume.BitLockerProtection:=System.Volume.BitLockerProtection#Encrypting OR System.Volume.BitLockerProtection:=System.Volume.BitLockerProtection#Suspended; no item read met that condition.

label: Pin to Quick access
behaviour: Shown on drive, extended-drive, removable.

label: Open Power&Shell window here
behaviour: Shown on extended-drive, with Shift held only.

label: Resume &BitLocker protection
behaviour: Shown only where System.Volume.BitLockerProtection:=System.Volume.BitLockerProtection#Suspended AND System.Volume.BitLockerRequiresAdmin:=System.StructuredQueryType.Boolean#False; no item read met that condition.

label: Resume &BitLocker protection
behaviour: Shown only where System.Volume.BitLockerProtection:=System.Volume.BitLockerProtection#Suspended AND System.Volume.BitLockerRequiresAdmin:=System.StructuredQueryType.Boolean#True; no item read met that condition.

label: &Unlock Drive...
behaviour: Shown only where System.Volume.BitLockerProtection:=6; no item read met that condition.
